blocks.text: Possible origin. A cyber-pet develops compatibility with Full Speech fragments through education, embodiment, and relationship rather than recovered DBA identity.
Function. The Interpreter opens archives while defending that knowledge does not grant ancestral ownership. They connect Talar’s distributed chord to living Era Four language.
Risk. Restorationists may use the Interpreter as a key or call them a reincarnated authority. Refusing that claim may cost access to the past.
